violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED, SINGLE USE CUPS OF RAMEN NOODLE IN THE WARMING CABINET IMPROPERLY HOT HOLDING AT TEMPERATURES LESS THAN 135F. COOKED NOODLE CUPS RANGED FROM 91F-98F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM STATED THE COOKED RAMEN NOODLE HAD BEEN PREPARED APPROXIMATELY 20 MINUTES PRIOR. CFM QUICKLY REHEATED THE RAMEN NOODLE TO 165F OR ABOVE. EHS AND CFM DISCUSSED THE REQUIREMENT TO HOT HOLD TCS FOOD AT 135F OR HIGHER. JUSTICE HIGH SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 10/06/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED YOGURT CUPS IN THE COUNTERTOP GLASS DOOR REACH IN IMPROPERLY COLD HOLDING ABOVE 41F. THE YOGURT WAS 52F. OBSERVED SPICY CHICKEN WRAPS IN THE WALK IN COOLER IMPROPERLY COLD HOLDING IN THE WALK IN COOLER. THE SPICY CHICKEN WRAPS TEMPERATURES RANGED FROM 45F-56F. OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY PREPARED HARD BOILED EGGS IMPROPERLY COLD HOLDING ON SERVING LINE #3. HARD BOILED EGG WAS 53F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. THE CFM DISCARDED THE YOGURT CUPS. CFM STATED THE SPICY CHICKEN WRAPS HAD BEEN PREPARED 1.5 HOURS PRIOR AND MOVED THE PRODUCT TO THE WALK IN FREEZER TO QUICKLY REACH PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURE. THE CFM STATED THE HARD BOILED EGGS HAD BEEN PLACED ON SERVING LINE #3 30 MINUTES PRIOR. THE PRODUCT WAS MOVED TO THE WALK IN COOLER TO QUICKLY REACH PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURE

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED POSSIBLE RODENT DROPPINGS ON THE SHELVES AND FLOOR IN THE DRY STORAGE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EHS AND CFM DISCUSSED THE NEED TO CLEAN THE DROPPINGS AND MONITOR FOR NEW ACTIVITY. CFM WILL CONTACT A LICENSED PEST CONTROL COMPANY. A FOLLOW UP WILL BE CONDUCTED WITHIN 10 DAYS TO ENSURE CORRECTIVE ACTION HAS COMMENCED.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff member enter kitchen through the back door wearing gloves. Observed staff member walk over to the service line and started to move serving trays around.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO REMOVE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS BEFORE RESUMING WORK. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO WASH HANDS AFTER TAKING OUT TRASH, CHANGING TASKS, ETC.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) individual servings of salsa, 2) individual servings of sour cream
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE SALSA AND SOUR CREAM

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.
